# Calendar row styling preserves user font scale at the slotted content boundary

D238704 design acceptance requires700 label weight and removes0.9rem content shrink because users can already choose a smaller base font. Fixed .row-label is1rem/700 and the slotted content layout does not add that shrink. The review also corrects the initial assumption that an outside stylesheet is redundant: density variables must enter from the outside, while component selectors use host/slot boundaries. This is accepted local Calendar row practice, not a universal700 weight or a rule banning every smaller font. Existing00491345a9897135fcff5790216453016c639ae5680dcd1c5c1c457aabc79b5b owns icon/clamp rendering limits. Slot identity assertions do not prove legibility, contrast or accessible naming. No visual/runtime test.

Scope: Calendar dialog row font and shadow style boundary.
